oid_policy: UUID-based OIDs under 2.25 as specified by ITU-T X.667 / ISO/IEC 9834-8. Each signature parameter set has one UUIDv4 assigned once; interpret its 128-bit value as an unsigned big-endian integer and write it in decimal. Persist every assignment; never regenerate UUIDs during build or provider initialization.
tls_policy: Pure signature over the TLS 1.3 CertificateVerify input; private-use SignatureScheme code points. Both peers must use this registry.
pkcs8_format: PrivateKeyInfo v0, absent AlgorithmIdentifier parameters. The privateKey OCTET STRING holds raw secret key followed by raw public key, using fixed descriptor lengths. Decoder also accepts the previous raw-secret-key-only representation.
